transcriber_notes: Rows: 35 per part = 7 blocks of 5 (總數 line + 持地持家 / 持地借家 / 借地持家 / 借地借家): 總數; 職業上ノ地位アル者 總數; 獨立者; 役員; 職工其他; 家事雇人; 職業上ノ地位無キ者. Columns: 總數 + 第一款 to 第七款 (8 count columns, then the same 8 as percentages). In the print the total line of each block stands slightly above its tenure lines and the figures sit about half a row above their labels; figures were assigned to labels in order.

Row label levels: column 1 = 總數 / 職業上ノ地位アル者 / 職業上ノ地位無キ者; column 2 = the sub-group (總數, 獨立者, 役員, 職工其他, 家事雇人) under 地位アル者; column 3 = 總數 or the tenure type. The block 總數 under 職業上ノ地位アル者 is the brace-labelled '總數' (its first line is the group total 548,138).

Row '職工其他 / 持地借家', col '總數': the last digit is partly joined to the column rule and cannot be read with confidence (5 or 3); written [?]. The other three tenure cells sum to 114,196, the block total printed is 114,459 and the row's 第一款-第七款 cells sum to 261 + 2 = 263; both would give 263, but this is not used to fix the digit (5-vs-3 is not covered by the settling rule).

Every other count reconciles: for every row 總數 = 第一款 + ... + 第七款 (six/seven columns; empty cells counted as 0); for every column the four tenure lines sum to the block 總數; 職業上ノ地位アル者 總數 (548,138 etc.) = 獨立者 + 役員 + 職工其他 + 家事雇人 in all columns, and 總數 = 地位アル者 + 地位無キ者 in all columns. 第七款 is printed only for 總數 (1,711) and 職業上ノ地位無キ者 (1,711); empty for all 地位アル者 blocks.

Percentages were checked against the counts (block share of its own 總數 line, 2 decimals): all agree except the cell 'row 總數 / 持地借家, col 第六款' printed '1.26' (the counts 30 / 11,676 give 0.26; the four 第六款 percentages 67.77 + 1.26 + 9.23 + 22.74 sum to 101.00). Kept as printed '1.26' — apparent misprint for 0.26.
Empty (dotted) cells are "": 役員 持地借家 一款/二款/五款/六款/七款, 家事雇人 持地借家 四款-七款, 地位無キ者 持地借家 四款/六款/七款 and so on, as shown in the rows. The 總數 row's percentages are 100.00 in every column. Rows: 35 as printed.
Unreadable: 1 cell ([?]).
